helpers.name: cm_slots_size_matches__temp_context
helpers.strategy: For all structs slots, cm_slots_wf structs slots implies cm_rep_members_size slots = cm_slots_size structs slots. Induct on slots; obtain head wellformedness at index 0 and tail wellformedness by shifting each valid index by 1, then apply the scalar slot equality and induction.

helpers.name: cm_temp_offset_matches__temp_context
helpers.strategy: For all policy p fid temp f, f=cm_function_at policy fid (cm_program_functions p), cm_slots_wf (cm_program_structs p) (cm_function_params f), and the analogous locals condition imply 8+cm_rep_members_size(params)+cm_rep_members_size(locals)+8*temp=cm_temp_offset policy p fid temp. Unfold cm_temp_offset and rewrite both list size equalities; no fid range premise.
